Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Red cell distribution width is elevated, suggesting anisocytosis. Electrolytes, renal, and liver function are within normal limits except for slightly elevated chloride and low AST. Findings may indicate chronic disease, possible infection or inflammation, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation is recommended.
